text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa, as Hero No. 1, I can't lose! I'm 
gonna be No. 1!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aiming for the Mile CS, Biko Pegasus 
dashed on. Her sharpness was truly 
first-class now, but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: One, two... One, two...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: *munch munch munch* ♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Here I come~. 
Thump-thump-thump-thump-thump☆

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Trainer, Bono's... Bono's...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: She's getting stronger and stronger!
choice_data_list: Ah, yeah... Look at that stride...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono's growth was phenomenal. She 
didn't just stop at catching up to Biko 
Pegasus...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She is truly about to enter her prime. If 
she runs with full mastery over that 
colossal stride...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I have to do my best! After all, Biko-chan 
told me that "I'm a hero too"☆

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Oh no... Did the carotene power I gave 
them create a terrifying, formidable 
rival...?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
This might be... Justice Biko's greatest 
crisis...
choice_data_list:
Biko, I'm not losing either—time for my 
closing kick!

Biko, I'm not gonna lose either—time for 
my closing kick!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Yeah...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And on the day of the Mile Championship.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, we did everything we could, 
didn't we...?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Today... I absolutely have to win!
choice_data_list: Yeah, you're the number one hero!
Yeah, you are the No. 1 hero!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer! I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As a Trainer, I've done everything I 
could. All that's left is—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: KABOOM!! Bono~ No. 2~!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Today Bono is... *That* Bono is...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
—It looks huge! ...Though I feel like it 
always does.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Biko-chan, come at me from wherever you 
want! I've got a super good feeling about 
today~."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
U-Uuuu... Where is this confidence coming 
from...? Even more than during the 
Sprinters Stakes...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Is this the end for Justice Biko? Will 
next year bring a brand-new series with a 
different protagonist?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Can I really not... beat Bono?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She's completely overwhelmed... At this 
rate, it's clear she'll be thrown out by 
the Yokozuna...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If you're outmatched in size and let your 
spirit get beaten too, there's no hope for 
you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
But I had already given her all the words 
of encouragement I could. As her Trainer, 
all that was left for me to do was—

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
Carotene charge!! Don't give up, 
Biko-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Huh... The one over there is...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Could it be... Onee-san?! Did you come to 
cheer for me?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Glancing to the side, I saw an action 
actress and a bearded American standing 
right there.

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
"Biko-chan, I did it! I finished shooting 
the movie I'm starring in!!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
My body is totally battered, but that was 
the best run yet! The director is thrilled 
too!

text_block_list.name: Film Director
text_block_list.text: That was wonderfuuul.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I see... So she pulled it off... 
Overcoming so many handicaps, she finally 
did it...

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
"Biko-chan! The same blood flows through 
you and me. The blood of orange."

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
As long as we have that burning blood, we 
can stand back up again and again!

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
"Even if your body is small, even if your 
legs are frail, you will not lose! For on 
your back—"

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
I have the "Wings" of dreams!! Justice 
Biko, Pegasus Form!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Wings of dreams...! Pegasus Form...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I see, you're right. I've always kept 
soaring, aiming to be a hero.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to charging straight toward 
my dream, I won't lose to anyone. That's 
right, not even Bono!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I want to be the strongest of all! I want 
to help people in need! And—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I want to be the hero everyone looks up 
to! I am going to... become a 
hero-o-o-o!!!

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text: Biko-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The soul sister who flew back from America 
inspired Biko Pegasus with fresh vigor.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A heart unbroken by adversity. That was 
the Carrot Spirit—Biko Pegasus in her 
truest element.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's do this, Bono! I'm not 
going to lose to you either. And—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
With the double justice power of strength 
and technique, I'll put on the ultimate 
race!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yeah, Biko-chan!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
New heroes of the sprint world. Two 
swooping lights ascend into the heavens.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Which of them will be the hero of the 
next generation? A clash of justice vs. 
justice between close friends begins."
